points: Preheat your oven to 220°C/200°C fan/gas mark 7.
Pour the water for the bulgur (see pantry for amount) into a large saucepan, stir in the chicken stock paste and bring to the boil.
Stir in the bulgur, bring back up to the boil and simmer for 1 min. Pop a lid on the pan and remove from the heat.
Leave to the side for 12-15 mins or until ready to serve.
steps.title: Boil the Bulgur

points: Meanwhile, halve the chicken breasts lengthwise down the middle to create two equal-sized, skin-on breasts.
Heat a drizzle of oil in a large frying pan on medium-high heat.
Once hot, lay the chicken into the pan, skin-side down. Season with salt and pepper.
Fry until golden, 5-6 mins, then turn and cook for 1 min on the other side.

notes.text: Slice the chicken apart carefully to ensure the skin remains intact.
Notice a stronger smell from your chicken? Don’t worry, this is normal due to packaging we use to keep it fresh.
Wash your hands and equipment after handling raw chicken and its packaging.

steps.title: Get Frying

points: While the chicken fries, in a medium bowl, mix together the edamame beans, sliced carrot and cabbage mix, half the green chilli paste, the mayo (see pantry for amount) and a drizzle of oil.
Season with salt and pepper. Set aside for now.
steps.title: Mix the Slaw

points: Transfer the chicken to a baking tray, skin-side up. Sprinkle over the Indonesian style spice mix and drizzle over some oil.
Roast on the top shelf until cooked, 12-15 mins.

notes.text: The chicken is cooked when no longer pink in the middle.

steps.title: Bake the Chicken

points: Meanwhile, pop a small saucepan on medium-high heat (no oil).
Add the peanut butter, vegan XO sauce, sweet chilli sauce and water for the sauce (see pantry for amount). Simmer, stirring, until thickened and combined, 3-4 mins.
Cut the chicken widthways into 2cm thick slices.
steps.title: Make the Sauce

points: Once the bulgur is ready, fluff up the grains with a fork and stir through the remaining green chilli paste.
Share the bulgur between your serving bowls. Top with the green chilli edamame slaw and sliced spiced chicken in separate sections.
Spoon the peanut XO sauce over the chicken and bulgur.
steps.title: Serve
